report.objective:
Device screen cleanup in the UI2 frontend: hide tabs and chips a device has no data for (management servers without own interfaces, standalone Cluster members), restore the Collect-now empty state, and stop offering Create credential to sessions that cannot create credentials. Full brief: # Task: device screen cleanup (frontend only)

Repository: this worktree (branch `w/luna-ui-0926`). Work only under `ui2/frontend/`. React + MUI + TypeScript,
tests with vitest. Product rule (Product Owner, 2026-09-25): **if a vendor/device lacks a kind of data, the UI does not
show that tab or chip at all** ("each vendor in its own terms"). All UI text is English.

## Changes

1. **Management servers without own interface evidence** — `src/screens/InventoryPanels.tsx`, `DeviceInventoryPanels`
   (the single-device branch, around the `DetailTabs` call and the header chip
   `` `${deviceIfaceCount} interfaces · ${deviceRouteCount} routes` ``).
   For a device with `role === "management_server"` whose inventory has **zero interfaces and zero routes**, do not
   render the `Interfaces` and `Routing` tabs and do not render that header chip. The first remaining tab
   (e.g. `Managed devices`, `Grid members`) becomes the default. Devices that do have interface or route evidence are
   unchanged. Non-management devices are unchanged (they keep the tabs, with the empty state of change 2).

2. **Empty-state wording regression** — `InterfacesPanel` (~line 1108) and `RoutesPanel` (~line 1182) currently say
   "No interface/routing records are available for this device. Management-server inventory may contain managed
   devices instead." for every device. Restore, for ordinary devices:
   - Interfaces: title `No interface evidence`, body `This device has not been collected yet. Use Collect now to read its interfaces.`
   - Routing: title `No routing evidence`, body `This device has not been collected yet. Use Collect now to read its routes.`
   (Management servers never reach this panel after change 1 when they have nothing; if one has evidence it shows it.)

3. **"Cluster members" tab on standalone devices** — same `DetailTabs` list, third tab. When the device is not a
   cluster member (`device.cluster_member_ref === null`) and is not an Infoblox grid manager and not a
   Blue Coat / Fortinet management server, do not render that tab at all (today it renders `Cluster members` with
   nothing meaningful for a standalone firewall).

4. **Add device dialog, credential link** — `src/shell/AddDeviceDialog.tsx` ~line 529: the `Create credential` button
   shows even when the session cannot create credentials (the dialog then says "You do not have permission to create
   credentials."). Show the button only when the session can create credentials. Find how the app already knows this
   (look at `CredentialsPanel.tsx`, the session/permissions context, `ACTION_REFUSED` handling); if the dialog cannot
   know it before trying, then after a refusal (`ACTION_REFUSED`) hide the button and show one sentence:
   `Ask an administrator to add a credential for this vendor.` Do not invent a new permission model.

## Tests (required)
Add or extend vitest tests under `ui2/frontend/tests/` (see `SmcInventory.test.tsx`, `ConfigurationRefresh.test.tsx`
for the rendering/mocking style):
- a Blue Coat management server with 0 interfaces/0 routes: no `Interfaces`/`Routing` tab, no "interfaces · routes"
  chip, `Managed devices` is selected;
- a management server with interfaces keeps its `Interfaces` tab;
- a standalone gateway: no `Cluster members` tab; its empty Interfaces panel shows "Use Collect now";
- a cluster member keeps `Cluster members`;
- the Add device credential link rule of change 4.

## Done means
- `cd ui2/frontend && npx tsc --noEmit -p . && npx vitest run` both green (all tests, not only yours).
- `npm run build` green.
- One commit on this branch, message in English, ending with the line `Co-Authored-By: gpt-6-luna (Codex)`.
- Do not push, do not deploy, do not touch anything outside `ui2/frontend/`, do not edit `project/`, `docs/`, or
  handover files. Do not add dependencies.
- Final message: list the files changed, the tests added, and the test/build output summary.
